title: packages: adopt-orphans skips the save door's judges — it adopts into an uninstalled package id, leaves an unprefixed object unsaveable (422 NAMESPACE_PREFIX), and moves flows and datasets only after a restart
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbL6Nn3scsU8yvLyU4

Filing gate: ① product defect with a measured reach, found by the #37453 investigation (os-dev report comment 7184476778, readings A1–A3). Source: fleet. Sub-issue of #37424 (phase 4: it is the door the loose-item clean-up runs through).
Grade: area:package · Bug · p2 · severity Broken (an adopted item can no longer be saved) on an admin-only door; reach: public HTTP door `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/adopt-orphans` (and the ⋯ menu's 「收编散落项」), measured once each on origin/main a46efa8c by a local dogfood probe · evidence: measured.
Reader: area `ux-37424` (seat `repo:objectstack#5`), an `os-dev` subagent — after the maintainer answers question 3 on #37424 (whether this all-or-nothing door stays or a per-item move door replaces it); the fix shape follows that answer.
Dedupe: `adopt-orphans` → 66 hits; same family, all closed: #24813 (writability), #28776 / #28735 (prefix and owner judges for fields), #23646 / #23690 (registry write-through). None covers the three cases below.

## 维护者速读

- 用户会遇到什么：在软件包菜单里点「收编散落项」时，① 可以收编进一个根本没安装的软件包，收进去的项从此存不了；② 没带包前缀的对象收编后再也保存不了；③ 流程和数据集要重启服务后才换到新地址，中间按新地址访问是 404 / 409。
- 根因是同一个：收编接口没有走保存接口的那套检查。
- 怎么修取决于 #37424 的问题 3（散落项怎么清）：保留这个一次全收的接口就补上检查；改成逐条移动就由新接口统一走保存检查，旧接口退役。
- 需要你做的：无，问题 3 时一起问。

## What (measured; full readings in comment 7184476778 on #37453)

1. **Uninstalled id.** `POST /api/v1/packages/com.probe.ghost/adopt-orphans` answers 200 `reassignedCount 1`; `GET /packages/com.probe.ghost` answers 404; the next bare `PUT /meta/flow/...` answers 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` (the row inherits a binding to a package that does not exist). `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` ~3725–3737 notes that an id nothing installed passes `requireWritablePackage`; `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-commits.ts` `reassignOrphanedMetadata` (~872–1060) has no installed check, while the save door refuses a named base that is not installed (`protocol-package-scope.ts` ~102–139).
2. **Unprefixed object.** Adopting a package-less object `probe_widget` into namespace `zeta` answers 200; then `PUT /meta/object/probe_widget`, with `?package=` or bare, answers 422 `NAMESPACE_PREFIX`. `reassignOrphanedMetadata` judges owner, permission set and `__c`, not `objectNamespacePrefixViolation` (`protocol-save-door-refusals.ts` ~967) or the child-K rule.
3. **Registry write-through.** Right after a 200 adoption, `GET /automation/zeta/probe_loose_flow` answers 404 and `GET /meta/dataset/probe_env_ds?callerPackage=com.probe.zeta` answers 409 until a restart; `protocol-package-commits.ts` ~990–998 writes through only `view` and `object`.

## Acceptance

- Whatever door moves a package-less item into a package runs the save door's judges for the target (installed writable base, namespace prefix, child K, the ADR-0150 D3 (a) report of references left behind) and refuses with the save door's codes; each case above has a regression test red before, green after.
- An adopted flow / dataset (and every type the boot registers) answers at its new address without a restart.

Governing text: `docs/adr/0070-package-first-authoring.md` (D5), `docs/adr/0150-behavioural-metadata-addressed-by-package-objects-keep-the-literal-prefix.md`.
